description: DVB-S2 BCH known-answer tests generated from independent third-party encoder and decoder implementations; not official ETSI vectors.
scope: BCH outer code only; LDPC is not encoded, decoded, or validated by these vectors.

encoder.upstream_usage: Unmodified bch_bb_impl::general_work; output is the N_bch-bit systematic codeword.

decoder.upstream_usage: Unmodified bch_decoder_bb_impl with STANDARD_DVBS2 and OM_CODEWORD; one process per decode case.

sources.usage_notice: GPL upstream code and drivers remain outside the standards directory; this JSON contains test data and provenance only.

build.decoder_single_translation_unit_note: reference_bch_decode.cc includes bch_decoder_bb_impl.cc so bitman.hh external-linkage helpers are compiled once; the .cc is not linked separately.

bit_and_hex_format.encoding: lowercase hexadecimal, two digits per byte, MSB-first within each byte
bit_and_hex_format.decoded_message: The first k_bch bits of decoded_codeword_hex; not duplicated as a separate field.

message_generation.block_rule: SHA256(UTF8(label) || uint64_be(counter)), counter = 0,1,2,...; concatenate digest bytes
message_generation.truncate_rule: Take the first k_bch/8 bytes, then replace the first two bytes with 00 00

shortening_rule.description: full_k - k_bch implicit leading zero bits are prepended for the parent BCH code; they are not present in any transmitted hex field.
shortening_rule.additional_test_prefix: Each transmitted message separately starts with 16 explicit zero bits; these are included in message_hex and are not implicit shortening zeros.

error_injection.position_meaning: message first/middle/last, first parity bit, and final codeword bit
error_injection.reporting_note: The upstream decoder emits no correction-count line for error-free input, so reported_corrections is null there; fixed_5_errors cases must report exactly 5.

checks: Every encoder run consumed k_bch bits and produced n_bch unpacked binary bits.
Every encoded codeword starts with the exact input message.
Repeated encoding outputs are bit-identical for every combination.
Injected error positions are exactly the five specified positions.
Error-free and five-error decoder outputs both equal the independent encoder codeword bit-for-bit.
All decoder outputs and correction reports are identical across two independent process runs.
Every fixed-five-error decode reports exactly five corrections and no too-many-errors status.
All KATs passed; no expected parity or corrected output was calculated by this script.

limitations: These are third-party implementation known-answer tests, not official ETSI-published vectors.
They validate BCH only and provide no LDPC validation.
The fixed five-error cases do not replace tests beyond or at the correction-capability boundary.
